name: JustRL-DeepSeek-1.5B
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B (config.json max_position_embeddings 131072). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-25. An RL run on deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B, not a new base model: same config.json, same 1.777 parameters . Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2025-10-31. Caveats: Avg@K again (32 for AIME/AMC/HMMT/BRUMO/CMIMC, 4 for MATH-500/Minerva/OlympiadBench), so not pass@1-comparable. Single-stage RL with fixed hyperparameters over 4,000+ steps. Still behind BroRL on AIME24 (57.50) and MATH-500 (92.14), and behind ProRL-V2 on CMIMC25 (25.86).

benchmarks.name: OlympiadBench (avg@4)
benchmarks.config: Same table: 45.95 vs 67.99. BroRL still leads AIME24 (57.50) and MATH-500 (92.14).

benchmarks.name: AIME 2024 (training curve final)
benchmarks.config: Read off the card's training-curve figure, not the card table. Read by eye, caveat +-0.5; second read of the same annotation matched exactly (58.59, flagged end-of-training marker). Same figure prints BroRL 57.50 and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B 28.46 as reference lines, and +30.13 / +105.9% as the delta - all confirmed on the second read. NOT the same measurement as the AIME 2024 (avg@32) row on file at 52.6: the figure's title gives no avg@N and the two numbers cannot both be avg@32, so this is filed separately rather than overwriting or duplicating that row.
